title: Leslie Odom, Jr. and Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor Join Storm Reid in Teyana Taylor’s Directorial Debut ‘Get Lite’ (EXCLUSIVE)
content:
ByAngelique Jackson

Golden Globe winner and Oscar and Grammy nomineeTeyana Tayloris assembling an all-star cast for her feature directorial debut, “Get Lite,” starring Storm Reid and NFL rookie-turned-actor Ceyair Wright.

Tony winner and Oscar nominee Leslie Odom, Jr. (“Hamilton,” “One Night in Miami”) and Oscar nomineeAunjanue Ellis-Taylor(“King Richard,” “Lucky”) have joined the ensemble cast for the Paramount movie, which follows a talented but sheltered dance student who finds inspiration, love and family in the last place he expected: the subways of New York City. Wright (“Space Jam: A New Legacy”) is the student caught between worlds, while Reid (“The Last of Us,” “Euphoria”) is the girl who opens his life to new possibilities. Key to the dance movie is Litefeet, a high-energy style that originated in Taylor’s hometown of Harlem.

Production on “Get Lite” is set to begin this month in New York City; the film is dated for a wide theatrical release on Aug. 20, 2027. Taylor — who is coming off her acclaimed performance in “One Battle After Another” — directs from a screenplay by Maurice Williams, based on a spec script by Eric Gross that appeared on the Black List in 2020.

Indie hip-hop artist Khayr Bullock, Twitch streamer Tylil James and actor Woody McClain (“Power Book II: Ghost,” “The Harder They Fall”) are also confirmed to join the cast. Jodie Turner-Smith (“Queen & Slim,” “The Agency”) and Asante Blackk (“When They See Us,” “This Is Us”) are in negotiations for key roles.

In addition to starring in the film, Reid is on board to produce alongside Kenya Barris and Anni Weisband for Barris’ Khalabo Ink Society; Robyn Simpson for A Seed & Wings Productions, Reid’s banner; and Bill Karesh for Offbrnd. Taylor is also producing the film with Courtney “Coco” Gilbert, under their production banner The Aunties.

Taylor is represented by WME, Taylor Made Management and the Lede Company. CAA represents Reid, Odom, Jr. and Ellis-Taylor. Reid is also repped by the Lede Company and Granderson Des Rochers; Odom, Jr. by Untitled Entertainment and Jackoway Austen; and Ellis-Taylor by TMT Entertainment Group.

McClain is represented by Buchwald, M88, Align PR and Goodman, Genow, Schenkman, Smelkinson & Christopher; Turner-Smith is represented by UTA, the Lede Company, 111 Media and Johnson Shapiro Slewett & Kole; and Blackk is represented by Gersh, 1v1 Entertainment, the Lede Company and Del Shaw Moonves.
title_zh: 萊斯利·奧登·朱尼爾(Leslie Odom, Jr.)和安詹紐·艾利斯-泰勒(Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor)加入了斯托姆·瑞德(Storm Reid)的行列，參與泰雅娜·泰勒(Teyana Taylor)的導演處女作《輕鬆一下》(Get Lite)（獨家報導）。
content_zh:
由安潔莉克·傑克森(Angelique Jackson)報導

金球獎得主、奧斯卡和格萊美提名者泰雅娜·泰勒(Teyana Taylor)正在為她的首部長片導演處女作《Get Lite》籌備一個明星陣容，主演包括斯托姆·瑞德(Storm Reid)和從NFL新秀轉型為演員的塞亞爾·賴特(Ceyair Wright)。

托尼獎得主和奧斯卡提名者萊斯利·奧登·小(Leslie Odom, Jr.)（《哈密爾頓(Hamilton)》，《邁阿密之夜(One Night in Miami)》）以及奧斯卡提名者安詹紐·艾利斯·泰勒(Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor)（《國王理查德(King Richard)》，《幸運(Lucky)》）已加入這部派拉蒙影業(Paramount)的電影演員陣容。影片講述了一位才華橫溢但受限的舞蹈學生，在他意想不到的地方——紐約市的地鐵中，找到了靈感、愛情和家庭。賴特是這位在兩個世界之間掙扎的學生，而瑞德則是那位為他打開新可能性的女孩。這部舞蹈電影的關鍵是Litefeet，一種源自泰勒家鄉哈萊姆的高能量舞蹈風格。

《Get Lite》的製作計劃於本月在紐約市開始；該片定於2027年8月20日進行廣泛的影院上映。泰勒剛剛完成在《一場又一場的戰鬥(One Battle After Another)》中的備受好評的表演，將根據莫里斯·威廉姆斯(Maurice Williams)的劇本執導，該劇本基於埃里克·格羅斯(Eric Gross)於2020年出現在黑名單上的一部規格劇本。

獨立嘻哈藝術家凱爾·布洛克(Khayr Bullock)、Twitch主播泰利爾·詹姆斯(Tylil James)和演員伍迪·麥克萊恩(Woody McClain)（《權力書II：鬼魂(Power Book II: Ghost)》，《他們越過的困境(The Harder They Fall)》）也已確認加入演員陣容。喬迪·特納·史密斯(Jodie Turner-Smith)（《女王與瘦子(Queen & Slim)》，《機構(The Agency)》）和阿桑特·布萊克(Asante Blackk)（《他們看見我們(When They See Us)》，《這就是我們(This Is Us)》）正在洽談重要角色。

除了在電影中擔任主演外，瑞德還將與肯亞·巴里斯(Kenya Barris)和安妮·維斯班德(Anni Weisband)共同製作，巴里斯的Khalabo Ink Society、瑞德的A Seed & Wings Productions以及比爾·卡雷什(Bill Karesh)的Offbrnd也參與製作。泰勒還與科特妮·“可可”·吉爾伯特(Courtney “Coco” Gilbert)共同製作該片，並在他們的製作公司The Aunties下進行。

泰勒由WME、泰勒製作管理(Taylor Made Management)和Lede Company代表。CAA代表瑞德、奧登·小和艾利斯·泰勒。瑞德還由Lede Company和Granderson Des Rochers代表；奧登·小由Untitled Entertainment和Jackoway Austen代表；艾利斯·泰勒則由TMT Entertainment Group代表。

麥克萊恩由Buchwald、M88、Align PR以及Goodman, Genow, Schenkman, Smelkinson & Christopher代表；特納·史密斯由UTA、Lede Company、111 Media和Johnson Shapiro Slewett & Kole代表；布萊克則由Gersh、1v1 Entertainment、Lede Company和Del Shaw Moonves代表。
